scope: interpretation of fixed contrasts; no method, score, cohort, comparator or evaluator changes
old_v4_contract_mapping: Old McFaline V2-vs-Magnitude/V1 rules are not confirmation of the different Orion Source3285 method. The .005 practical point margin and -.005 noninferiority interpretation are reported separately from positive CI evidence.
primary_cohort: primary_common fixed by evaluator: known-history and all registered methods finite, after legal n>=30 TEST cell QC; both original contexts n>=20 before bootstrap

uncertainty.unit: joint biological gene cluster across contexts and methods

interpretation_levels.practical_point_improvement: macro delta_U20>=.005; alone does not establish statistically supported superiority
interpretation_levels.noninferiority_style_guard: paired95CI lower>=-.005; can include zero and is not superiority
interpretation_levels.supported_positive_increment: macro delta_U20>=.005 AND paired95CI lower>0; describe nominal statistical support conditional on fixed fits

Public_increment_with_source_budget_fixe.interpretation: Public information package; not isolated effect-content or Quality gain

primary_no_support_action: Preserve all fixed results, mark primary source-transfer increment not established; no champion selection, refit, test-driven parameter update or promotion of another method.
manual_secondary_scope: Report fixed Manual pair with nominal intervals; if primary fails do not relabel Manual as preselected primary or claim primary success.
no_history_scope: separate unsupported-history cohort; no universal fallback claim
